name: Joshua Turek
desc: American politician and former wheelchair basketball player
summary: Joshua Peter Turek (born April 12, 1979) is an American politician and former wheelchair basketball player who is a United States senator-elect from Iowa. He has served since 2023 as a member of the Iowa House of Representatives from the 20th district. A member of the Democratic Party, he was the party's nominee in the 2026 United States Senate election in Iowa, defeating Republican nominee Ashley Hinson.
